Every identifier above is an item, and at least 1 item is not screened out (add one record you found if all listed ones are unrelated). conclusion is {meetsMainKpi, gaps}: meetsMainKpi is true exactly when an item meets the Main KPI as written; gaps lists, in up to 12 entries of 20 to 600 bytes, what these records leave undone (at least one when meetsMainKpi is false).
